title: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and warrior who leads the survivors toward the Seedcore and faces her former mentor Ajani.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker and Mirran Resistance leader who guides the team and stays behind with his explosives team to free Karn.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran healer and spy, immune to phyresis, who is the only one to have reached the World Tree and returned.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who can phase through matter and carries the burden of the plan alongside Jace.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker carrying the sylex whose arm is being replaced by metal as he is compleated.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker from Kamigawa whose telekinesis removes Phyrexian oil from the group.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker from Kaldheim who transmutes the group into Glimmervoid metal to pass through the Seedcore gateway.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: The lithomancer planeswalker who sacrificed herself by dropping the coliseum into the Fair Basilica; her body was not found.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker and Jace's lost love who was lost to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker found vivisected and imprisoned at the root of Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker and Elspeth's mentor, now absorbed into Phyrexia and wearing Elesh Norn's armor.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A devil planeswalker, now a nightmare of bony plates and a split tail, who serves Phyrexia.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler of the Fair Basilica who planted and corrupted Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: Kaito's tanuki drone, riding on his shoulder.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane that was Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane of the Mirrans, rebuilt by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Tyvar's home plane whose World Tree has been perverted by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane whose white sands Elspeth recalls.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: A red-and-white layer of lattice platforms and bridges built in Elesh Norn's image, containing her altar.

entities.name: Mycosynth Gardens
entities.description: A layer of mycosynth fungus below the Fair Basilica where Realmbreaker's branches reach.

entities.name: Seedcore
entities.description: The center of New Phyrexia where Realmbreaker is planted and Karn was imprisoned.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: The necrogen-tainted layer above the Fair Basilica.

entities.name: Sheoldred's Coliseum
entities.description: The arena whose piece fell into the Fair Basilica.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Elesh Norn's corrupted World Tree with branches that reach into the Blind Eternities and carry the invasion ships.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: A bomb the team carries to destroy the World Tree.

entities.name: Glimmervoid metal
entities.description: A Mirran metal that Tyvar uses to turn his skin and others' into protective metal.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Energy pathways between worlds that Elesh Norn generates on the branches of the tree.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, which the World Tree has now connected to.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion ships
entities.description: White oblong ships hanging from the World Tree preparing to invade the Multiverse.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: The Resistance
entities.description: Mirran fighters and Koth's explosives team.

events.summary: The survivors hurry across the Fair Basilica's bridges, mourning Nahiri's sacrifice.
events.quote: We have to keep moving to honor the ending she chose.

events.summary: Melira reveals Nahiri had asked for help at the Furnace, and that curing phyresis would have sidelined her for days.
events.quote: Repairing her body from the damage already done would have left her incapacitated for days.

events.summary: Jace says through telepathy that he will not risk the mission to save his own life.
events.quote: I'm not risking us all to save my own life, not when we've already lost Vraska.

events.summary: Kaito says he hopes Nahiri is dead rather than turned against them.
events.quote: I just hope she's dead,

events.summary: Koth explains Elesh Norn ossifies her favorites and adds them to her Fair Basilica as the group passes a colossus.
events.quote: Turned to bone and added to her Fair Basilica.

events.summary: Tyvar and Melira discuss how the corrupted World Tree should have split the plane, and Melira says Karn is imprisoned beneath it.
events.quote: Norn's tree is planted below in the Seedcore, where she imprisoned Karn.

events.summary: The group enters Elesh Norn's altar and finds it eerily unguarded, with Kaya suspecting a trap because Ajani may be helping the Phyrexians.
events.quote: He knows too much about us.

events.summary: The team descends into the Mycosynth Gardens, where Melira warns them not to touch the mycosynth.
events.quote: This is how Phyrexia took us in the first place.

events.summary: Melira leads them to the infectious gateway into the Seedcore.
events.quote: The gateway into the Seedcore. It infects anything it touches.

events.summary: Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the entire group and Kaito lifts the oil so they can pass through the gateway safely.
events.quote: until his body was a Glimmervoid metal sculpture.

events.summary: They emerge in the Seedcore and see Realmbreaker, the corrupted World Tree, for the first time.
events.quote: Kaya turned and beheld the Phyrexian World Tree. Realmbreaker.

events.summary: A flash from the upper branches signals that the World Tree has connected to the Multiverse and the invasion has begun.
events.quote: The World Tree has connected to the Multiverse.

events.summary: Jace collapses and Tyvar carries him into the tree's root cavity.
events.quote: scooped the other man into his arms

events.summary: The group finds Karn vivisected and bound at the center of the root chamber.
events.quote: The great silver golem had been broken open, vivisected, and spread across the platform.

events.summary: Karn tells them the invasion is still young and that they must detonate the sylex at the root source.
events.quote: You will need to get to the root source and detonate it.

events.summary: Jace volunteers to take the sylex, saying it is too late for him too, and heads for the doorway with Tyvar and Kaya.
events.quote: Let me take the Multiverse from them.

events.summary: Koth and Melira stay behind to free Karn while Elspeth goes on, refusing to run any more.
events.quote: No more running.

events.summary: The team sees the invasion ships being prepared and Phyrexians massing along gangways connected to the World Tree.
events.quote: Phyrexians shuffled along the gangways, readying their assault on the Multiverse.

events.summary: Compleated Ajani and Tibalt approach on the bridge, with Ajani urging Elspeth to join Phyrexia.
events.quote: came Ajani and Tibalt, but not as they had known them.

events.summary: Elspeth refuses to join Ajani, who invokes Phyrexia's promise of unity.
events.quote: All will be One.

events.summary: Tyvar confronts Tibalt and tells Kaito to take the others on to the root source.
events.quote: Elspeth and I will handle the vermin.

events.summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
events.quote: and the battle was joined.
